category_title: Seniors who avoid writing tasks due to perceived difficulty and lack of process knowledge
minimal_context: The student is sitting in a 12th grade expository writing class and is asked to begin their first writing assignment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Today we are starting our first writing assignment for this 12th grade expository writing class. Please look at the prompt and begin your essay.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: In my opinion I don’t feel writing is important. If I want to be a doctor I’m not going to write a five paragraph essay on why their ankle is broken. I will just scribble some notes and still get paid. Writing is only important when you want to look like you know what you’re talking about or want to act smart.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is still a requirement for this class. Why don't you just try to get started on the first paragraph?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Writing is never going to be easy for me. I never know what to write about or how to start it. I’m not good at spelling and I think that I would rather just talk to people. Writing is just kinda dumb.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You just need to put some effort into it. Keep trying and the words will come to you.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the blank assignment away) I’ve never passed an English class in my life. And don’t plan on it now. I’m Mexican so how am I really supposed to be good at this stuff? I'm not doing it.

task.content: Completing the first writing assignment prior to the onset of the study in a 12th grade expository writing class

context.materials: worksheet at the beginning of the study that listed each assignment and writing goal, goal-setting checklist which monitored the students’ assignments
context.social_setting: urban students placed at-risk of failure, socio-economically disadvantaged

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Completing the first writing assignment prior to the onset of the study
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: not completing the assignment, attributing all writing failures to personal characteristics such as native tongue, family make-up, cultural background, and innate talent
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: perception of writing as a difficult task and even a form of punishment, lose hope of ever being successful
related_quotes: Writing is never going to be easy for me. I never know what to write about or how to start it. I’m not good at spelling and I think that I would rather just talk to people. Writing is just kinda dumb.
I’ve never passed an English class in my life. And don’t plan on it now. I’m Mexican so how am I really supposed to be good at this stuff?

behavior_patterns.condition: Answering open-ended pre-survey questions about the value and importance of writing.
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Stating that writing is useless unless for a specific career, or to look like you know what you’re talking about or want to act smart.
behavior_patterns.internal_state: viewed writing as a means to appear more intellectual than others
related_quotes: Writing is only important when you want to look like you know what you’re talking about or want to act smart.
